title: Claude designs protein binders for 15 targets
summary: After an initial prompt, Claude selected binding sites, used design and folding models, and chose candidates, with success on 14 of 15 targets. Of 1,320 designs, 354 bound, for rates of 22–35% versus a typical 10–15%. None of the 90 designs for the maltose-binding protein worked. External labs ran the tests.
